packageRules.description: uv is pinned in mise.toml AND every setup-uv version: input in test-template.yml, with no maintainer-side test asserting they agree. Renovate sees both (mise depName 'uv'; github-actions depName 'astral-sh/uv') but would bump them in separate PRs. Match on the shared packageName so BOTH are disabled — matchDepNames: ['uv'] would silence only the mise side. Bump uv manually across all six sites instead.
